metadata.title: Vorchain: see the material shortages your ERP does not show
metadata.description: Vorchain plans with your suppliers' real delivery delays and warns you about shortages before your ERP shows them. Your data never leaves your browser.

home.title: See the material shortages your ERP does not show
home.tagline: Vorchain plans with your suppliers' real delays instead of their promised dates.

hero.eyebrow: For production planners in mid-sized manufacturing
hero.note: Free, no sign-up, with sample data or your own exports.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: Your ERP plans with the delivery date your supplier promised. Many suppliers regularly deliver a few working days later.

points.promised: In the ERP, stock looks fine until the promised receipt.
points.late: When the goods arrive late as usual, the shelf is empty before then.
points.hidden: These hidden risks only show up when the line stops.

export.title: Export your data
export.text: Export materials, open purchase orders, demand and delivery history from your ERP as CSV or Excel.

analyse.title: Plan realistically
analyse.text: Vorchain measures each supplier's typical delay (80th percentile in working days) and projects your stock day by day with it.

act.title: Act where it matters
act.text: You get a ranked list of critical materials, each with the reason and a concrete next step.

privacy.title: Your data never leaves your browser
privacy.text: The demo reads and analyses your files only locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, stored or sent to analytics services.
privacy.proof: An automated test checks on every change that no network request carries file content.

data.question: What data do I need?
data.answer: Four exports from your ERP: materials with stock on hand, open purchase orders, demand and the delivery history with promised and actual delivery dates. German and English column names are recognised.

integration.question: Do I have to connect or change my ERP?
integration.answer: No. Vorchain works with CSV or Excel exports your ERP can already produce.

delay.question: How is the real delay calculated?
delay.answer: From the delivery history: for each supplier we take the delay in working days that 80% of deliveries did not exceed. With fewer than three deliveries we flag the thin data.

upload.question: Are my files uploaded?
upload.answer: No. The analysis runs entirely in your browser. Your files are never sent to our server or to any third party.

cost.question: What does Vorchain cost?
cost.answer: The demo is free. For a pilot with your own data, just get in touch.

cta.title: See shortages sooner
cta.text: Want to try Vorchain with your own data or have questions? Write to us.

demo.title: Interactive demo
demo.lead: Check your material supply against real supplier delays. Your files are read only in your browser and never leave your computer.

dataSource.heading: 1. Choose data
dataSource.intro: Start with our sample data or choose your own ERP exports as CSV or Excel files (.csv, .xlsx). Materials, open purchase orders, demand and delivery history are required; suppliers are optional.
dataSource.dropHint: or drop them here – several files at once (.csv, .xlsx)
dataSource.templates: Download the sample files as templates

status.loading: Reading your data in the browser …
status.complete: All required tables recognised. The data is ready for analysis.
status.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# problem found} other {# problems found}}. See the details next to the tables below.

mapCheck.heading: 2. Recognised tables
mapCheck.intro: This is how your files were assigned. Fix hints appear next to the table they concern.

errors.EMPTY_FILE: The file is empty. Please export the table from your ERP again.
errors.NOT_TEXT: This is not a CSV text file ({detected, select, zip {probably an Excel file named .csv; rename it to .xlsx} utf16 {UTF-16 encoded; save it as CSV UTF-8} other {binary data; save the table as CSV or .xlsx}}).
errors.UNCLOSED_QUOTE: A quotation mark is never closed, so the rest of the file would be one cell. Please check this line.
errors.MALFORMED_QUOTE: Text follows a closing quotation mark (e.g. "12" inch"). Please double quotation marks inside a field or remove them.
errors.INVALID_NUMBER: “{value}” is not a valid number. Use e.g. 1234.5, 1,234.5 or 1.234,5.
errors.INVALID_DATE: “{value}” is not a valid date. Use e.g. 2026-10-05 or 05.10.2026.
errors.UNKNOWN_TABLE: The table was not recognised – columns found: {found}. Rename the file to e.g. materials.csv, open_purchase_orders.csv, demand.csv, supplier_history.csv or suppliers.csv.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_TABLE: The columns fit several tables ({candidates}). Please give the file a clear name, e.g. open_purchase_orders.csv.
errors.MISSING_COLUMNS: {count, plural, one {Column {missing} not found} other {Columns {missing} not found}} – columns found: {found}. Please rename the column in the header row.
errors.MISSING_VALUE: A required value is missing. Please delete ERP totals rows (e.g. “Summe;;1.234” without an ID) from the file before loading it.
errors.TOO_MANY_ERRORS: More than {limit} rows have errors; only the first {limit} are shown. Please check the export’s delimiter, number and date format.
errors.DUPLICATE_TABLE: The table {table} is already in {other}. Please remove one of the two files.
errors.MISSING_TABLE: The table {table} is missing. Please add a file, e.g. {example}.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Files {extension, select, none {without an extension} other {with the extension .{extension}}} are not supported. Please save the table as CSV or Excel workbook (.xlsx).
errors.PASSWORD_PROTECTED: The Excel file is password-protected. Please save a copy without a password.
errors.CORRUPT_FILE: The Excel file is damaged or incomplete. Please export it again.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: {unit, select, bytes {The data is larger than {limit, number} MB.} unpackedBytes {The Excel file is larger than {limit, number} MB when unpacked.} other {The table has more than {limit, number} rows.}} Please export only the columns and rows you need.
errors.ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT: The analysis took longer than 30 seconds and was stopped. Please try again with smaller files.
errors.WORKER_FAILED: The analysis failed unexpectedly. Please reload the page and try again.

warnings.DUPLICATE_MATERIAL: Material number “{value}” appears more than once (first in line {firstRow}). Both rows are analysed; please check the export.

settings.heading: 3. Settings
settings.asOfHint: First day of the projection, usually the date of the ERP export.
settings.horizonHint: {min} to {max} calendar days from the as-of date.
settings.horizonInvalid: Please enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

tiles.hiddenHint: Not visible in the ERP view, or only later

overdue.note: {count, plural, one {# open purchase order is overdue} other {# open purchase orders are overdue}} (promised before the as-of date). The ERP view no longer counts them; the realistic view books them with the supplier's typical delay.
overdue.notListed: The material is not in the list; the ERP view may still show it running short. Please confirm the date with the supplier.

table.caption: Materials at risk of a shortage, most urgent first ({shown} of {total})
table.empty: No stock-outs and no drop below safety stock in the next {days} days.

suppliers.heading: Supplier delivery reliability
suppliers.caption: Supplier delivery reliability, least reliable first
suppliers.intro: Delay in working days between promised and actual delivery date, from the delivery history.
suppliers.empty: No delivery history, so no supplier statistics.

reasons.NO_OPEN_PO: No open purchase order covers the demand.
reasons.PO_AFTER_CRITICAL: {poId} is promised for {promised} – already after the critical date.
reasons.PO_LATE: {poId} is promised for {promised}, but {supplier} is typically {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} late (on-time rate {rate, number, percent}).
reasons.PO_LATE_LOW_CONFIDENCE: Only {deliveries, plural, one {# past delivery} other {# past deliveries}}, low confidence.
reasons.HIDDEN_ERP_LATER: The ERP view (promised dates) shows the problem only from {erpDate}: hidden risk.
reasons.HIDDEN_ERP_NONE: The ERP view (promised dates) shows no problem at all: hidden risk.
reasons.PO_OVERDUE: {poId} was promised for {promised} and is overdue; the ERP view does not count it, realistically it arrives on {realistic}.

actions.PLACE_ORDER: {known, select, yes {Order now from {supplier}.} other {Order now from the main supplier (not on file).}}
actions.PULL_FORWARD: Ask {supplier} to pull {poId} forward before {before}, or source elsewhere.
actions.EXPEDITE: Expedite {poId} or ask for a partial delivery before {before}.
actions.REVIEW_QTY_OR_DEMAND: Increase the order quantity or check the demand plan.

drawer.title: Stock projection {materialId}
drawer.intro: Day by day for {days} days from {asOf}: ERP view with the confirmed delivery dates (dashed) and realistic view with the supplier's typical delay (solid).
